snippet.title: Exark - Official Teaser Trailer | Engine-Builder Autobattler Roguelike
snippet.description:
🛠️ Wishlist Exark on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435610/Exark/

Say hello to Exark, a run-based engine builder/autobattler set aboard a massive ark-ship.
Build and upgrade rooms, assign your crew, and push your synergies to the limit to keep your Great House alive. 
Developed by Robot Cat Limited and coming soon under our publishing banner! 🔥
